_instructions: OPERATOR-CURATED synonyms + opposites for the B1.9 pole-logic sanity test. The builder MERGES this file and it TAKES PRECEDENCE over WordNet auto-harvest, and it SURVIVES rebuilds. For each target word set 'synonyms' to same-SENSE synonyms (as used in the item context) and 'opposites' to TRUE antonyms / direct contrast words for that word (NOT generic opposite-pole words). Leave an array EMPTY to fall back to auto-harvest (which will be flagged NEEDS_MANUAL_REPLACEMENT). Aim for 4 synonyms + 4 opposites each. After curating, run build_b1_9_pole_sanity_scaffold.py, review, then set word_groups_approved=true in b1_9_pole_sanity_items.json. Keys starting with '_' are ignored.
